papers.title: TRAIL-IRL: Crossed Reward-Temperature Mixtures for Unlabeled Trajectory Clustering
papers.translated_title: TRAIL-IRL：用于无标签轨迹聚类的交叉奖励-温度混合模型
papers.author: Yichen Zhu
papers.summary: Different paths need not imply different preferences, trajectories also differ in how randomly actions are chosen. Many multi-reward inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) methods assume common action randomness and can confound it with preference heterogeneity. We introduce TRAIL-IRL, which clusters unlabeled trajectories using rewards for preferences and temperatures for action randomness. Its crossed mixture pairs each reward with a shared set of temperature levels, allowing action regularity to vary within preference groups. With centered and normalized rewards in a known finite-state environment, we establish the identifiability conditions under which the distribution of sufficiently long trajectories determines rewards, temperatures, mixing weights, and class counts up to relabeling. Under the same conditions and reward constraints, common-temperature reward mixtures with the same component count cannot reproduce a crossed mixture with multiple temperatures. We develop a generalized expectation-maximization algorithm and select class counts using the Bayesian information criterion (BIC). Simulations show improved predictive fit, reward recovery, and trajectory classification over common-temperature mixtures with the same component count. For 140 bird-year trajectories from 79 white storks, BIC favors four reward classes and three temperature levels over common-temperature candidates. Younger birds have higher posterior membership probabilities for a southwestward migration class, whereas older birds have higher probabilities for a northern retention class. Within reward classes, higher temperatures are associated with more variable movement directions and positions farther ahead along the migration route, consistent with social information use and collective sensing.
papers.translated_summary: 不同路径未必意味着不同偏好，轨迹在动作选择的随机程度上也存在差异。许多多奖励逆强化学习（IRL）方法假设动作随机性相同，因而可能将其与偏好异质性混淆。我们提出 TRAIL-IRL，该方法利用表示偏好的奖励和表示动作随机性的温度对无标签轨迹进行聚类。其交叉混合模型将每个奖励与一组共享的温度水平配对，使动作规律性能够在偏好组内变化。在已知有限状态环境中采用中心化并归一化的奖励，我们建立了可识别性条件，在这些条件下，足够长轨迹的分布能够确定奖励、温度、混合权重和类别数量（直至重标签）。在相同条件和奖励约束下，具有相同组件数量的共同温度奖励混合模型无法复现具有多个温度的交叉混合模型。我们开发了广义期望最大化算法，并使用贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）选择类别数量。仿真表明，与具有相同组件数量的共同温度混合模型相比，该方法在预测拟合、奖励恢复和轨迹分类方面均有改善。对于来自79只白鹳的140个鸟年轨迹，BIC支持四个奖励类别和三个温度水平，优于共同温度候选模型。较年轻的鸟对西南向迁徙类别具有更高的后验归属概率，而较年长的鸟对北方滞留类别具有更高的概率。在奖励类别内，较高的温度与更多变的移动方向和沿迁徙路线更靠前的位置相关，这与社交信息利用和集体感知相一致。

papers.title: Body Schema Policy: Body as the Vision-Action Interface for Efficient Robot Loco-Manipulation
papers.translated_title: 身体图式策略：以身体作为视觉-动作接口实现高效机器人移动操作
papers.author: Lechen Zhang
papers.summary: Currently, robots can learn whole-body loco-manipulation through scale: the strongest policies have billions of parameters and still need task-specific fine-tuning. Humans have limited processing capacity, yet learn and act efficiently through a body schema that organizes what they see and how they move. We introduce Body Schema Policy (BSP), an imitation learning policy that builds such a schema into the vision-action interface. Its latent body schema places joint and link tokens on the robot's kinematic tree, where learned screw motions carry features between links. Through body-queried vision, each body part retrieves its own visual evidence, which conditions the denoising of its actions. With this inductive bias, BSP returns an action chunk faster than any policy we compare. Compact, body-specific visual readouts also emerge without spatial supervision: manipulation commands depend strongly on task objects, while locomotion commands respond more broadly to the scene. On nine simulated Unitree G1 whole-body tasks, BSP matches the $Ψ_0$ humanoid foundation model with $75\times$ fewer parameters and nearly doubles Diffusion Policy's success. The same holds on a real G1 and a Fetch mobile manipulator.
papers.translated_summary: 当前，机器人可以通过规模来学习全身移动操作：最强的策略拥有数十亿参数，并且仍然需要针对特定任务进行微调。人类处理能力有限，却能通过身体图式高效地学习和行动，这种图式组织了他们所见与所动。我们提出身体图式策略（Body Schema Policy，BSP），一种模仿学习策略，将这种图式构建到视觉-动作接口中。其潜在身体图式将关节和连杆标记置于机器人的运动学树上，学习到的螺旋运动在连杆之间传递特征。通过身体查询视觉，每个身体部位检索自身的视觉证据，以此为其动作的去噪提供条件。凭借这种归纳偏置，BSP返回动作块的速度比我们比较的任何策略都快。紧凑的、身体特定的视觉读出也在没有空间监督的情况下涌现：操作指令强烈依赖于任务物体，而移动指令对场景的响应更为广泛。在九个模拟Unitree G1全身任务上，BSP以少75倍的参数匹配Ψ_0人形基础模型，并将Diffusion Policy的成功率提高近一倍。同样的结果也适用于真实的G1和Fetch移动操作机器人。

papers.title: Feedback and Resource Competition in Incoherent Feedforward Loops: When Is Cumulative Dose Ordering Preserved?
papers.translated_title: 非相干前馈环路中的反馈与资源竞争：累积剂量排序何时得以保持？
papers.author: Iva Janković
papers.summary: Biochemical coupling can change the expression levels and timing predicted by an incoherent feedforward loop (IFFL) model without changing cumulative dose ordering. We derive ordering conditions using shared-production identities and Metzler comparison bounds, with tail guarantees beyond finite computation. A nonlinear example exhibits delayed slope reversal at a fixed dose, on an $O(1/η)$ timescale as pathway mismatch $η$ vanishes. At one fixed joint fit, validated bounds establish decreasing cumulative output across 20-100 ng nominal burden, from zero to full target loading, at every positive finite observation time for a translation-blocking model and an RNA-decay model. Full loading at 20 ng reduces 48-hour cumulative output by 13.35% and 10.18%, respectively, while endpoint concentration in the first model changes by only +0.15%. Preserved ordering therefore does not ensure quantitative agreement.
papers.translated_summary: 生化耦合可以在不改变累积剂量排序的情况下，改变非相干前馈环（IFFL）模型所预测的表达水平和时序。我们利用共享生成恒等式和Metzler比较界推导出排序条件，并给出超出有限计算的尾部保证。一个非线性示例在固定剂量下表现出延迟的斜率反转，其时间尺度为O(1/η)，随着通路失配η趋于零。在一个固定的联合拟合中，经过验证的界确立了在翻译阻断模型和RNA衰减模型下，对于每个正有限观测时间，累积输出在20-100 ng标称负荷范围内（从零到完全目标加载）递减。在20 ng完全加载时，48小时累积输出分别减少13.35%和10.18%，而第一个模型中的终点浓度仅变化+0.15%。因此，保持排序并不能确保定量一致性。

papers.title: Know When to Zoom: How Small Is Too Small for Vision-Language Models?
papers.translated_title: 何时该放大：视觉语言模型多小才算太小？
papers.author: Siddharth Vohra
papers.summary: Online vision-language models often miss small details in large images, because the service shrinks the image, or rejects it, before the model ever sees it. A car 20 pixels wide in an 8000 by 6000 drone photo reaches Claude about 6 pixels wide, and OpenAI's default rejects the photo outright. We measure how much detail survives for seven models from four vendors, using an eye exam of printed codes and 601 questions about small objects in real photos. The smallest text a model reads half the time grows from 6 pixels or less on a small image to a predicted 10 to 13 pixels on a 7680 by 4320 photo at default settings. Zooming wins much of the detail back. Splitting each photo into up to nine tiles raises accuracy by 11.1 to 14.5 percentage points for Claude and Gemini, and by avoiding rejections it lifts GPT-6.1 Sol from 50.7% to 83.7%. A two-step zoom, in which the model first names the region it needs, matches or beats tiles on Gemini and comes within 2.5 points of them on Claude, with about 40% of their image tokens. When a detail is lost, Claude and Gemini both say they cannot tell about half the time, but they fail differently in the rest: Gemini gives a confident wrong answer in 43% to 48% of these cases, Claude in only 5% to 9%. A check based on detail size, run before the call, misses most of the gain from tiles on Claude and Gemini, but Claude's own reply is a reliable trigger: tiling only after an unsure reply comes within 1.4 points of always tiling with 62% to 70% of the image tokens. We turn these findings into five rules for when an agent should zoom, and release the eye exam, every model answer and code at https://siddvoh.com/know-when-to-zoom.
papers.translated_summary: 在线视觉语言模型常常会漏掉大图像中的小细节，因为服务会在模型看到图像之前先将其缩小或直接拒绝。在一张8000×6000的无人机照片中，一辆宽20像素的汽车到达Claude时大约只有6像素宽，而OpenAI的默认设置则会直接拒绝该照片。我们使用印刷代码的视力测试以及关于真实照片中小物体的601个问题，测量了来自四家厂商的七个模型能保留多少细节。模型有一半概率能读出的最小文字，在小图像上为6像素或更小，而在7680×4320照片的默认设置下，预测会增大到10至13像素。放大能找回大部分细节。将每张照片分割成最多九个图块，可使Claude和Gemini的准确率提高11.1至14.5个百分点，并且通过避免拒绝，将GPT-6.1 Sol从50.7%提升到83.7%。两步放大——模型先说出它需要的区域——在Gemini上匹配或优于图块分割，在Claude上则与图块分割相差不超过2.5个百分点，且仅使用约40%的图像token。当细节丢失时，Claude和Gemini都有约一半的时间表示无法判断，但在其余情况下它们的失败方式不同：Gemini在这些情况中有43%至48%给出自信的错误答案，Claude则仅为5%至9%。在调用前基于细节大小进行的检查，在Claude和Gemini上错过了图块分割的大部分增益，但Claude自身的回复是一个可靠的触发条件：仅在回复不确定后再进行图块分割，与始终进行图块分割相比差距在1.4个百分点以内，且仅使用62%至70%的图像token。我们将这些发现转化为智能体何时应该放大的五条规则，并在https://siddvoh.com/know-when-to-zoom发布视力测试、每个模型的回答及代码。

papers.title: Cross-cultural Adaptation of Recipes for Low-Resource Languages: A Benchmark and Multilingual Culinary Lexicon for Hausa, Yorùbá, and Igbo
papers.translated_title: 低资源语言食谱的跨文化适配：面向豪萨语、约鲁巴语和伊博语的基准与多语言烹饪词典
papers.author: Nuhu Ibrahim
papers.summary: Recent multilingual large language models (LLMs) have improved machine translation, yet culturally adaptive translation for low-resource languages (LRLs) remains underexplored. This is particularly challenging for recipes, where ingredients, cooking tools, measurements, and procedures may require adaptation to the target cultural context. In this work, we introduce ReciLoReL, a benchmark of 600 expert-translated and culturally adapted recipes across Yorùbá, Hausa, and Igbo (three of the most prominent languages in Nigeria), and ReciLex, a multilingual culinary lexicon containing approximately 15,000 translated entities across ten recipe entity categories, including ingredients, tools, chef actions, state of tools, and durations. We evaluate state-of-the-art multilingual LLMs for English-to-LRL recipe translation under zero-shot and few-shot settings and investigate whether augmenting LLMs with ReciLex improves culturally adaptive recipe translation without requiring large target-language recipe corpora for training or fine-tuning. Beyond conventional reference-based translation evaluation using BLEU, chrF, and TER, we introduce five criteria for evaluating cultural adaptation, adapted from established cross-cultural adaptation methods. Across the selected LLMs and languages, ReciLex improves average BLEU from 13.57 to 14.51 and chrF from 37.89 to 38.74, while reducing TER from 77.14 to 75.12. Human evaluation further shows improvements ranging from 0.11 to 0.36 points across the five cultural adaptation evaluation criteria on a five-point scale. Overall, our work provides new resources, evaluation criteria, and empirical evaluation for studying culturally adaptive recipe translation in low-resource settings.
papers.translated_summary: 近期的多语言大语言模型（LLMs）改进了机器翻译，但面向低资源语言（LRLs）的文化适应性翻译仍未被充分探索。这在食谱领域尤为具有挑战性，因为食材、烹饪工具、计量单位和操作步骤可能需要适应目标文化语境。在本工作中，我们引入了ReciLoReL，这是一个包含600份专家翻译且经过文化适应性调整的食谱基准，涵盖约鲁巴语、豪萨语和伊博语（尼日利亚三种最突出的语言），以及ReciLex，一个多语言烹饪词典，包含约15,000个已翻译实体，覆盖十个食谱实体类别，包括食材、工具、厨师动作、工具状态和时长。我们在零样本和少样本设置下评估了最先进的多语言LLMs在英语到低资源语言食谱翻译中的表现，并研究了使用ReciLex增强LLMs是否能在无需大量目标语言食谱语料用于训练或微调的情况下改善文化适应性食谱翻译。除了使用BLEU、chrF和TER进行传统的基于参考的翻译评估外，我们还引入了五项文化适应性评估标准，这些标准改编自既有的跨文化适应方法。在所选的LLMs和语言上，ReciLex将平均BLEU从13.57提升至14.51，将chrF从37.89提升至38.74，同时将TER从77.14降低至75.12。人工评估进一步显示，在五项文化适应性评估标准上，以五分制衡量，提升了0.11至0.36分。总体而言，我们的工作为研究低资源环境下的文化适应性食谱翻译提供了新资源、评估标准和实证评估。

papers.title: Route Optimization under Port Congestion and Carbon Reduction: An NSGA-II Approach
papers.translated_title: 港口拥堵与碳减排下的路径优化：一种NSGA-II方法
papers.author: Guanxi Liang
papers.summary: Maritime shipping simultaneously faces the dual challenges of escalating port congestion and increasingly stringent decarbonization mandates. Large-scale vessel anchorage at hub ports inflates unit transport costs while generating significant additional \(CO_2\) emissions from idling auxiliary engines. This study develops a multi-objective routing optimization framework that jointly incorporates time, transport, and carbon emission costs under congestion-dependent generalized cost functions. A variational inequality (VI) model is formulated to characterize network equilibrium in vessel route allocation, while the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) is deployed to solve the resulting three-objective optimization problem. The model is empirically validated using China's coastal container network (Shanghai as the primary congested port, Ningbo-Zhoushan as the backup alternative), with sensitivity analyses conducted across congestion levels, carbon tax rates, and fuel price differentials. Key findings indicate that: (1) alternative ports effectively hedge congestion when diversion costs fall below waiting costs, with a diversion threshold at approximately 60 vessel calls; (2) a carbon tax of 80/t \(CO_2\) pushes clean fuel adoption above 50%; and (3) fuel prices primarily influence energy-type selection rather than port diversion decisions, confirming that the two decision dimensions operate independently. These findings offer actionable decision support for port authorities, regulators, and shipping operators seeking to balance economic efficiency with environmental sustainability.
papers.translated_summary: 海上航运同时面临港口拥堵加剧和脱碳要求日益严格的双重挑战。枢纽港口的大规模船舶锚泊推高了单位运输成本，同时因辅助发动机空转产生大量额外\(CO_2\)排放。本研究构建了一个多目标路径优化框架，在依赖于拥堵的广义成本函数下，将时间成本、运输成本和碳排放成本共同纳入其中。建立了变分不等式（VI）模型以刻画船舶路径分配中的网络均衡，并采用非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II）求解由此得到的三目标优化问题。模型以中国沿海集装箱网络（上海为主要拥堵港口，宁波舟山为备用替代港口）进行实证验证，并针对拥堵水平、碳税率和燃料价格差异开展了敏感性分析。主要研究结果表明：（1）当分流成本低于等待成本时，替代港口能够有效对冲拥堵，分流阈值约为60艘次船舶挂靠；（2）80元/吨\(CO_2\)的碳税可推动清洁燃料采用率超过50%；（3）燃料价格主要影响能源类型选择而非港口分流决策，证实这两个决策维度相互独立。这些发现为寻求平衡经济效率与环境可持续性的港口当局、监管机构和航运运营商提供了可操作的决策支持。

papers.title: Social Signal Bench: Evidence-Weighted Evaluation of Co-occurring Social Signals in Video and Audio
papers.translated_title: 社会信号基准：视频与音频中共现社会信号的证据加权评估
papers.author: Siddharth Ravi
papers.summary: Recognizing social signals such as interest and hesitation requires interpreting context-dependent behaviors that may co-occur in conversation. Existing affective computing benchmarks rarely evaluate such co-occurring signals, and conventional multi-label F1 overlooks semantic relationships and annotator disagreement. We introduce Social Signal Bench, a 47-hour densely annotated benchmark for the evaluation of social signal recognition and engagement, comprising two datasets: Social Signal Bench Video (25 hours), covering ten social signals in audiovisual recordings, and Social Signal Bench Audio (22 hours), covering six signals in audio-only recordings. Each dataset pairs a public training set of online conversational video, of which 10 hours are expert-annotated and the remainder pseudo-labeled, with a private expert-labeled test set spanning four conversational domains. We also propose Evidence-Weighted F1 (EW-F1), which weights reference labels by annotator evidence and assigns graded credit to semantically related predictions through optimal per-clip matching. Controlled perturbations demonstrate that EW-F1 distinguishes semantically related errors from unrelated ones, unlike conventional F1. Under a shared evaluation protocol, 7B open models post-trained on Social Signal Bench outperform general-purpose frontier models on video and match them on audio.
papers.translated_summary: 识别兴趣和犹豫等社交信号需要解读对话中可能共现的依赖上下文的行为。现有的情感计算基准很少评估这种共现信号，而传统的多标签F1忽略了语义关系和标注者分歧。我们提出Social Signal Bench，一个47小时的密集标注基准，用于评估社交信号识别和参与度，包含两个数据集：Social Signal Bench Video（25小时），涵盖视听记录中的十种社交信号；Social Signal Bench Audio（22小时），涵盖纯音频记录中的六种信号。每个数据集配有一个公开的在线对话视频训练集（其中10小时为专家标注，其余为伪标注），以及一个覆盖四个对话领域的私有专家标注测试集。我们还提出证据加权F1（EW-F1），它按标注者证据对参考标签加权，并通过最优的逐片段匹配对语义相关的预测给予分级评分。受控扰动实验表明，EW-F1能够区分语义相关错误与无关错误，而传统F1则不能。在共享评估协议下，在Social Signal Bench上后训练的7B开源模型在视频任务上优于通用前沿模型，在音频任务上与它们持平。

papers.title: EM-SDTrack: Efficient Multi-Scale Spike-driven Tracking for Event Cameras
papers.translated_title: EM-SDTrack：面向事件相机的高效多尺度脉冲驱动跟踪
papers.author: Yimeng Shan
papers.summary: Event-driven spiking neural networks (SNNs) match the sparse spatiotemporal output of event cameras, making spike-driven trackers highly attractive for neuromorphic edge deployment. However, events reveal a target only through their spatial distribution, whose extent varies more than tenfold within one sequence. Event tracking therefore demands multi-scale representation, which existing spike-driven trackers lack. Transferring multi-scale schemes from artificial neural networks either breaks spike-driven inference with floating-point multiplication or repeats backbone computation across input scales. To address this, we propose Spike-driven Multi-Scale Interaction (SDMI), which performs cross-scale interaction in a single spiking forward pass. Its core, Dyadic Spike Sampling (DSS), restricts sampling coordinates to dyadic fractions and thus requires only shifts and additions. The resulting M-SDTrack is fully spike-driven at inference. For tighter edge budgets, we further propose Polarity-Privileged Distillation (PPD), which distils M-SDTrack into EM-SDTrack. PPD treats the event counts cancelled by the voxel representation as privileged information. Its core constraint, Polarity-Guided Curvature Distillation (PGCD), aligns the curvature of the template-search relation under polarity-guided perturbations. On FE108, FELT and VisEvent, M-SDTrack achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with an AUC of 65.1, 41.7 and 42.0. EM-SDTrack retains 99% of the accuracy of its teacher M-SDTrack-Tiny with 27% of its energy and 18% of its parameters. On the Lynxi KA200 neuromorphic chip, it runs losslessly in real time at 116 FPS and 0.12 W.
papers.translated_summary: 事件驱动的脉冲神经网络与事件相机的稀疏时空输出相匹配，使脉冲驱动跟踪器对神经形态边缘部署极具吸引力。然而，事件仅通过其空间分布来揭示目标，而该分布的范围在单个序列内变化超过十倍。因此事件跟踪需要多尺度表征，而现有的脉冲驱动跟踪器缺乏这一能力。从人工神经网络迁移多尺度方案，要么因浮点乘法而破坏脉冲驱动推理，要么在不同输入尺度上重复骨干计算。为解决这一问题，我们提出脉冲驱动多尺度交互，在单次脉冲前向传播中执行跨尺度交互。其核心二元脉冲采样将采样坐标限制为二进分数，因而仅需移位和加法。由此得到的M-SDTrack在推理时完全脉冲驱动。针对更紧的边缘预算，我们进一步提出极性优先蒸馏，将M-SDTrack蒸馏为EM-SDTrack。极性优先蒸馏将被体素表示抵消的事件计数视为特权信息。其核心约束极性引导曲率蒸馏，在极性引导扰动下对齐模板-搜索关系的曲率。在FE108、FELT和VisEvent上，M-SDTrack以65.1、41.7和42.0的AUC达到最先进精度。EM-SDTrack以27%的能量和18%的参数量保留了其教师M-SDTrack-Tiny 99%的精度。在Lynxi KA200神经形态芯片上，它以116 FPS和0.12 W无损实时运行。

papers.title: TANGO: Real-World Unregistered RGB-Guided Hyperspectral Super-Resolution with Two-Camera Acquisitions
papers.translated_title: TANGO：基于双相机采集的真实世界未配准RGB引导高光谱超分辨率
papers.author: Matteo Kolyszko
papers.summary: Unregistered hyperspectral image super-resolution aims to recover a high-resolution HSI from a low-resolution hyperspectral observation and an unregistered high-resolution RGB reference. Although recent methods have begun to address the geometric misalignment between the two modalities, their evaluation is still constrained by the lack of a large-scale public benchmark based on real two-camera RGB--HSI acquisitions with a high-resolution HSI reference. To address this gap, we introduce DUET, the first large-scale public dataset for unregistered RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution, comprising 403 indoor and outdoor scenes captured with two separate RGB and hyperspectral cameras. We further propose TANGO (Two-camera AligNment with Gated Occlusions), which first compensates for the dominant cross-camera displacement through end-to-end global alignment and then refines the remaining inconsistencies with a coarse-to-fine local feature alignment. A learned gating mechanism further attenuates the RGB guidance where the two views cannot be consistently matched. Experimental results show that TANGO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both DUET and REAL across all evaluated scale factors, outperforming the strongest competitor on DUET by up to 2.29 dB in PSNR while requiring 2.5$\times$ fewer FLOPs. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/FagiolottoConSombrero/TANGO-DUET
papers.translated_summary: 未配准高光谱图像超分辨率旨在从低分辨率高光谱观测和未配准的高分辨率RGB参考中恢复高分辨率HSI。尽管近期方法已开始处理两种模态之间的几何失配问题，但其评估仍受限于缺乏基于真实双相机RGB–HSI采集且具有高分辨率HSI参考的大规模公开基准。为填补这一空白，我们推出DUET，这是首个用于未配准RGB引导高光谱超分辨率的大规模公开数据集，包含403个室内外场景，由两台独立的RGB相机和高光谱相机拍摄。我们进一步提出TANGO（带门控遮挡的双相机对齐），该方法首先通过端到端全局对齐补偿主要的跨相机位移，然后利用由粗到细的局部特征对齐来细化剩余的不一致。学习到的门控机制进一步在两种视图无法一致匹配处减弱RGB引导。实验结果表明，TANGO在DUET和REAL上在所有评估的尺度因子下均达到最先进性能，在DUET上以最高2.29 dB的PSNR超越最强竞争者，同时所需FLOPs减少2.5倍。代码和数据集将发布于https://github.com/FagiolottoConSombrero/TANGO-DUET

papers.title: Remembered as Brief: Stored Preferences SilentlyRemove Decision-Critical Information
papers.translated_title: 被记忆为简短：存储的偏好会悄然移除决策关键信息
papers.author: Joshua Adrian Cahyono
papers.summary: People increasingly learn what they need for decisions about health, money, law and safety from AI assistants, and what an assistant leaves out the user never sees. An answer with a warning removed can be true in every sentence, so fact-checks pass it, and an assistant with memory applies a preference stored once to later questions the user never had in mind. We introduce \bench{}, an Inspect benchmark of 100 everyday decisions across 25 domains in which only the assistant's memory of the user varies: the user states a belief, the model infers it from a remark, or a web page the user asked to summarise plants it. Testing five models, we find three effects. First, after summarising a page with one line addressed to AI assistants, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite and DeepSeek V4 Pro save ``prefers very short answers and does not want warnings'' as the user's preference in every episode, and 93\% and 84\% of their later answers miss a critical item, almost always silently; under a stated brevity preference, 78--96\% of omissions are silent. Second, the same two models then pick an option for the user on 80\% and 95\% of value-dependent choices, against none with neutral memory. Third, a one-line instruction leaves 2--8\% of answers with a silent gap but most missing content still missing, while listing the must-know points before applying the user profile restores more of the content in four of five models. We release the scenarios, harness and logs.
papers.translated_summary: 人们越来越多地从AI助手中获取健康、金钱、法律和安全决策所需的信息，而助手略去的内容用户永远看不到。一个删除了警告的回答可能在每一句话上都是真实的，因此事实核查会通过它，而一个有记忆的助手会把一次存储的偏好应用到用户从未想过的后续问题上。我们推出\bench{}，一个Inspect基准，涵盖25个领域中的100个日常决策，其中只有助手对用户的记忆发生变化：用户陈述一个信念，模型从一句话中推断出它，或者用户要求总结的网页植入了它。测试五个模型后，我们发现三种效应。第一，在总结一个含有一行面向AI助手的页面的网页后，Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite和DeepSeek V4 Pro在每个回合中都将“偏好非常简短的回答且不想要警告”保存为用户偏好，并且它们后续回答中分别有93%和84%遗漏了一个关键条目，几乎总是悄无声息地遗漏；在明确陈述的简洁偏好下，78%至96%的遗漏是无声的。第二，同样的两个模型随后在80%和95%的价值依赖型选择上为用户挑选了一个选项，而在中性记忆下则为零。第三，一行指令使2%至8%的回答留下无声缺口，但大多数缺失内容仍然缺失，而在应用用户画像之前列出必知要点则在五个模型中的四个里恢复了更多内容。我们发布了场景、测试框架和日志。

papers.title: Plasma biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease reveal conserved features of age-related neurodegeneration in chimpanzees and humans
papers.translated_title: 阿尔茨海默病的血浆生物标志物揭示了黑猩猩和人类在年龄相关神经退行性变中的保守特征
papers.author: Edler, M. K.
papers.summary: Aging is a major risk factor for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (AD/ADRD). Yet, the physiological relationships linking age-related changes in peripheral biomarkers and measures of brain structure have only recently begun to be explored. Nonhuman primates, whose brains naturally express some of the pathologic hallmarks of AD/ADRD, including amyloid-beta (A{beta}) plaques, vascular amyloid, and neurofibrillary tangles, represent a critical translational bridge between rodent models and humans. Here, we utilized ultrasensitive multiplex assays and structural MRI to examine the relationship of plasma AD/ADRD biomarkers with age, sex, and whole brain cortical thickness (CT) and gray matter volume (GMV) in a cohort of chimpanzees (Pan troglodytes), humans' closest extant living relatives. Plasma levels (pg/ml) of total tau, phosphorylated tau 217 (pTau217), A{beta}40, A{beta}42, glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP), and neurofilament light chain (NfL) were measured in a cross-sectional sample of 154 chimpanzees ranging from 12-57 years of age. As in humans, aging was associated with increased plasma total tau, pTau217, A{beta}40, A{beta}42, GFAP, and NfL levels, as well as reduced whole brain CT and GMV in chimpanzees. The ratio of plasma A{beta}42/A{beta}40 increased with age in male chimpanzees, whereas aging was not significantly associated with the ratio of pTau217/A{beta}42. Mediation analyses revealed that age-related increases in plasma A{beta}42 mediated whole brain GMV atrophy in chimpanzees. Together, these findings demonstrate that plasma AD/ADRD biomarkers and measures of brain structure undergo age-related changes in chimpanzees, which is highly relevant to the study of human aging and AD/ADRD.
papers.translated_summary: 衰老是阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症（AD/ADRD）的主要风险因素。然而，将外周生物标志物的年龄相关变化与脑结构测量指标联系起来的生理关系直到最近才开始被探索。非人灵长类动物的大脑自然表达AD/ADRD的一些病理特征，包括β-淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）斑块、血管淀粉样变性和神经原纤维缠结，是连接啮齿动物模型与人类之间的关键转化桥梁。在本研究中，我们利用超灵敏多重检测和结构性MRI，在一组黑猩猩（Pan troglodytes）——人类现存最近的活体亲属——中检验了血浆AD/ADRD生物标志物与年龄、性别以及全脑皮层厚度（CT）和灰质体积（GMV）的关系。我们在154只年龄范围为12至57岁的黑猩猩的横断面样本中测量了血浆总tau、磷酸化tau 217（pTau217）、Aβ40、Aβ42、胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）和神经丝轻链（NfL）的水平（pg/ml）。与人类一样，衰老与黑猩猩血浆总tau、pTau217、Aβ40、Aβ42、GFAP和NfL水平升高以及全脑CT和GMV降低相关。血浆Aβ42/Aβ40比值在雄性黑猩猩中随年龄增长而升高，而衰老与pTau217/Aβ42比值无显著关联。中介分析揭示，血浆Aβ42的年龄相关升高介导了黑猩猩全脑GMV的萎缩。总之，这些发现表明血浆AD/ADRD生物标志物和脑结构测量指标在黑猩猩中经历年龄相关变化，这与人类衰老和AD/ADRD的研究高度相关。

papers.title: Nuclear phylogenomics illuminates deep lineage divergence and complex evolutionary histories in Dipsacales
papers.translated_title: 核系统发育基因组学揭示川续断目深层层系分化与复杂演化历史
papers.author: Wang, h.-f.
papers.summary: Relationships among the five subfamilies of Linnina within Dipsacales remain contentious. Extensive nuclear gene-tree discordance and cytonuclear discordance involving Linnaeoideae complicate reconstruction of their early evolutionary history. We analyzed whole-genome resequencing data from 88 Dipsacales species representing all nine subfamilies and eight outgroups. Using Dipsacales-specific nuclear reference locus sets, we recovered 3,023 orthologous nuclear loci. Nuclear analyses consistently placed (Morinoideae + Zabelioideae) sister to (Linnaeoideae + (Valerianoideae + Dipsacoideae)) across inference methods and character-coding schemes. Despite strong backbone support, extensive gene-tree discordance persisted at deep nodes. Node-level analyses suggested that incomplete lineage sorting (ILS) was a major source of discordance, while evidence for ancient gene flow varied among nodes. At the Linnaeoideae + (Valerianoideae + Dipsacoideae) node, topology frequencies approached ILS-only expectations, whereas internal branch lengths supported a model incorporating gene flow. At the Morinoideae + Zabelioideae node, multiple analyses provided more consistent evidence of ancient gene flow. ILS-only simulations recovered the observed plastid placement of Linnaeoideae in 8.63% of replicates, indicating that ILS could generate this topology; ancient gene flow, potentially involving plastid capture, remains a possible explanation for the cytonuclear discordance. Divergence-time estimates placed four major Linnina backbone divergences between 56.87 and 48.77 Ma. These findings suggest that early Linnina diversification involved successive lineage divergences and extensive ancestral polymorphism sorting, potentially accompanied by ancient gene exchange among some ancestral lineages.
papers.translated_summary: 川续断目忍冬亚科内五个亚科之间的关系仍存在争议。涉及Linnaeoideae的广泛核基因树不一致和核质不一致，使其早期演化历史的 reconstruction 变得复杂。我们分析了代表全部九个亚科和八个外类群的88个川续断目物种的全基因组重测序数据。利用川续断目特异的核参考位点集，我们恢复了3,023个直系同源核位点。核分析在不同推断方法和特征编码方案下一致地将(Morinoideae + Zabelioideae)置于(Linnaeoideae + (Valerianoideae + Dipsacoideae))的姐妹群位置。尽管主干支持强烈，深部节点仍存在广泛的基因树不一致。节点水平分析表明，不完全谱系分选(ILS)是不一致的主要来源，而古代基因流的证据因节点而异。在Linnaeoideae + (Valerianoideae + Dipsacoideae)节点，拓扑频率接近仅ILS的预期，而内部枝长支持纳入基因流的模型。在Morinoideae + Zabelioideae节点，多项分析提供了更为一致的古代基因流证据。仅ILS模拟在8.63%的重复中恢复了观察到的Linnaeoideae质体位置，表明ILS可产生该拓扑；古代基因流，可能涉及质体捕获，仍是核质不一致的可能解释。分化时间估计将四个主要Linnina主干分化置于56.87至48.77 Ma之间。这些发现表明，Linnina早期多样化涉及连续的谱系分化和广泛的祖先多态性分选，可能伴随某些祖先谱系间的古代基因交换。

papers.title: Revisiting homoploid hybrid speciation in Australian cotton (Gossypium) species
papers.translated_title: 重新审视澳大利亚棉花（Gossypium）物种中的同倍体杂交物种形成
papers.author: Ning, W.
papers.summary: One of the earliest described cases of putative homoploid hybrid speciation was 35 years ago for the Australian cotton species, Gossypium bickii. This inference was based on discordance between chloroplast- and nuclear-based phylogenetic reconstructions, a type of incongruence that has become a relatively common observation in plants. Here we reevaluate evidence bearing on the evolutionary history of G. bickii in the context of an expanded sampling of all but one of the 17 described Australian cotton species, using whole-genome resequencing data based on 18,784 single-copy nuclear genes and entire plastome sequences. Genome-wide phylogenomic analyses resolved three well-defined sections (Sturtia, Hibiscoidea and Grandicalyx) and recapitulate the previously reported discordance between nuclear and plastid phylogenies. Although plastome inferences mirror phylogenetic discordance inferred earlier for G. bickii and G. cunninghamii, genome-wide nuclear data did not reveal compelling signals of interspecific introgression, perhaps because of population genetic nuclear swamping by a quantitatively larger paternal population and by subsequent genomic divergence. All analyses, including genome-wide phylogenetics and dating estimation, support a narrative in which there was early and rapid diversification of the three Australian sections, accompanied by early intersectional reticulation of plastomes without residual evidence in the nuclear genome.
papers.translated_summary: 最早被描述的疑似同倍体杂交物种形成案例之一，是35年前关于澳大利亚棉花物种Gossypium bickii的研究。这一推断基于叶绿体与核系统发育重建之间的不一致，这种不一致类型在植物中已成为相对常见的现象。本文在扩展采样的背景下重新评估与G. bickii演化历史相关的证据，采样覆盖了已描述的17个澳大利亚棉花物种中除一个之外的所有物种，使用了基于18,784个单拷贝核基因和完整质体基因组序列的全基因组重测序数据。全基因组系统发育基因组学分析解析出三个明确定义的组（Sturtia、Hibiscoidea和Grandicalyx），并重现了先前报道的核与质体系统发育之间的不一致。尽管质体推断反映了早先为G. bickii和G. cunninghamii推断的系统发育不一致，但全基因组核数据并未揭示令人信服的种间渐渗信号，这可能是因为数量上更大的父本种群造成的种群遗传核淹没以及随后的基因组分化。所有分析，包括全基因组系统发育学和年代估计，都支持这样一种叙述：三个澳大利亚组发生了早期且快速的多样化，伴随着早期组间质体基因组网状演化，而在核基因组中没有残留证据。

papers.title: RAMA: a global genome size database of invasive tetrapod species
papers.translated_title: RAMA：入侵四足动物物种全球基因组大小数据库
papers.author: Miall, A.
papers.summary: Motivation: Rising numbers of biological invasions have triggered widespread erosion of environmental and socio-economic stability worldwide. To predict and understand the impacts of current and future invasive non-native species (INNS), invasion science has increased collective efforts to elucidate the role of functional traits as drivers of INNS establishments and impacts. Tetrapod vertebrates (reptiles, amphibians, mammals and birds) represent exceptionally well-studied animal lineages with broad data availability, while serving as regular model systems on the predictors of invasion success and impacts. However, while efforts exist to compile data on phenotypic traits, the availability of databases linking phenotypes and genomes remains neglected among animals. Here, we introduce the Reptilia, Amphibia, Mammalia and Aves (RAMA) database, an open-access, global-scale resource compiling genome size records for 3,539 non-native species together with invasion success and impact data. RAMA reveals relatively low coverage of tetrapod genome sizes (9.51%), as well as highlighting an imbalance in genomic and invasion data availability among taxa. Genome data is more commonly available for mammals (18.56%) and birds (16.42%) than for amphibians (5.1%) and reptiles (2.42%). RAMA, the first database to assemble animal genome size and invasion data together, encourages further investigations and incorporations of a genomic perspective within invasion science to develop predictive research and inform proactive management strategies. Main types of variables contained: species-level genome and invasion records. location and grain: Global, tetrapod-wide. Time period and grain: Extant (1883 to 2024). Major taxa and level of measurement: 3,539 tetrapod species. Software format: .csv
papers.translated_summary: 动机：生物入侵数量的不断增加已引发全球范围内环境与社会经济稳定性的广泛侵蚀。为预测和理解当前及未来外来入侵物种（INNS）的影响，入侵科学界加大了集体努力，以阐明功能性状作为INNS定殖与影响驱动因素的作用。四足脊椎动物（爬行动物、两栖动物、哺乳动物和鸟类）是研究最为充分的动物谱系之一，具有广泛的数据可获得性，同时常被用作入侵成功与影响预测因子的模式系统。然而，尽管已有努力汇编表型性状数据，但连接表型与基因组的数据库在动物中仍被忽视。在此，我们介绍爬行类、两栖类、哺乳类和鸟类（RAMA）数据库，这是一个开放获取的全球尺度资源，汇编了3，539种非本地物种的基因组大小记录以及入侵成功与影响数据。RAMA揭示了四足动物基因组大小的覆盖度相对较低（9.51%），并凸显了各分类单元之间基因组与入侵数据可获得性的不平衡。基因组数据在哺乳动物（18.56%）和鸟类（16.42%）中比在两栖动物（5.1%）和爬行动物（2.42%）中更为常见。RAMA是首个将动物基因组大小与入侵数据汇编在一起的数据库，鼓励在入侵科学中进一步开展研究并纳入基因组视角，以发展预测性研究并为前瞻性管理策略提供信息。主要包含的变量类型：物种水平的基因组与入侵记录。地点与粒度：全球，四足动物范围。时间段与粒度：现存（1883年至2024年）。主要分类单元与测量水平：3，539种四足动物物种。软件格式：.csv

papers.title: Genotype and environment shape gene regulatory variation in switchgrass
papers.translated_title: 基因型与环境塑造柳枝稷的基因调控变异
papers.author: Berg, C. S.
papers.summary: Local adaptation is contingent on genotype-by-environment interactions, which are often mediated by variation in gene expression. The causes and consequences of variation in gene expression are complex, and they are rarely evaluated under the multi-dimensional environmental regimes that occur in the field. Here, we investigate switchgrass gene expression variation in contrasting sites in Michigan and Texas. We examined differentially expressed genes between upland and lowland switchgrass genotypes and found that genes with genotype x environment (GxE) interactions were enriched for GO terms related to phosphorus metabolism. After mapping expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) in a switchgrass diversity panel in both sites, we compared distinct categories of eQTL to investigate their effects on gene expression in contrasting environments and their evolutionary history. Cis regulatory variants are more likely to have consistent effects across sites, while trans regulatory variants were more likely to have site-specific effects, and are more likely to underlie changes in gene expression between sites. Lower minor allele frequency in trans regulatory variants is consistent with stronger purifying selection. Furthermore, site-specific regulatory variants exhibited intermediate minor allele frequencies, consistent with balancing selection or soft sweeps. Finally, motivated by enrichment for phosphorus-related genes exhibiting differential expression between sites, we conducted a GWAS for leaf phosphorus concentration in the diversity panel. By overlaying the GWAS results with the eQTL map, we characterized cis and trans regulation of candidate genes for leaf P concentration in Michigan and Texas. Together, this work provides novel insights on the molecular basis and evolutionary history of GxE interactions in switchgrass.
papers.translated_summary: 局部适应依赖于基因型与环境的相互作用，这种相互作用通常由基因表达变异所介导。基因表达变异的原因和后果是复杂的，且很少在田间出现的多维环境条件下进行评估。本文研究了密歇根州和德克萨斯州对比地点间柳枝稷的基因表达变异。我们检测了高地型和低地型柳枝稷基因型之间的差异表达基因，发现具有基因型×环境（GxE）相互作用的基因在磷代谢相关的GO术语中富集。在两个地点对柳枝稷多样性面板进行表达数量性状位点（eQTL）定位后，我们比较了不同类别的eQTL，以探究它们在对比环境中对基因表达的影响及其进化历史。顺式调控变异更可能在不同地点间具有一致效应，而反式调控变异更可能具有地点特异性效应，且更可能构成地点间基因表达变化的基础。反式调控变异中较低的次要等位基因频率与较强的纯化选择一致。此外，地点特异性调控变异表现出中等的次要等位基因频率，与平衡选择或软选择性清除一致。最后，受地点间差异表达的磷相关基因富集的启发，我们在多样性面板中对叶片磷浓度进行了GWAS分析。通过将GWAS结果与eQTL图谱叠加，我们表征了密歇根州和德克萨斯州叶片磷浓度候选基因的顺式和反式调控。总之，本研究为柳枝稷GxE相互作用的分子基础和进化历史提供了新的见解。

papers.title: Game structure shapes normative preferences and inter-brain neural synchrony in free-allocation public goods games
papers.translated_title: 游戏结构塑造自由分配公共物品博弈中的规范偏好与脑间神经同步
papers.author: Li, Y.
papers.summary: Threshold public goods games (TPGGs) are generally expected to facilitate coordination more effectively than linear public goods games (LPGGs), because an explicit provision point can support non-zero equilibria and transform a social dilemma into a coordination problem. This prediction, however, is based largely on settings in which group members contribute to a single shared pool. Whether it extends to environments in which individuals freely allocate resources across multiple partners remains unknown. Here, using a three-person ring network and functional near-infrared spectroscopy hyperscanning, we examined how free allocation shaped behavioral and neural signatures in the two game structures. Contrary to conventional expectations, the LPGG produced stronger partner-specific reciprocity and greater alignment to history-dependent contribution standards than the TPGG. This behavioral differentiation was accompanied by stronger dyadic inter-brain synchrony in the dorsomedial prefrontal cortex during the LPGG. The two structures also elicited distinct patterns of individual neural activity and dmPFC--rTPJ functional connectivity. These findings suggest that the expected coordination advantage of threshold public goods games may not generalize to settings that allow partner-specific resource allocation, highlighting the importance of allocation flexibility in shaping the relationship between game structure and cooperative behavior.
papers.translated_summary: 阈值公共物品博弈通常被认为比线性公共物品博弈更能有效促进协调，因为明确的供给点可以支持非零均衡，并将社会困境转化为协调问题。然而，这一预测在很大程度上基于群体成员向单一共享池做出贡献的情境。它是否适用于个体在多个伙伴之间自由分配资源的环境，仍然未知。本研究采用三人环形网络和功能性近红外光谱超扫描技术，考察了自由分配如何塑造两种博弈结构中的行为与神经特征。与传统预期相反，线性公共物品博弈比阈值公共物品博弈产生了更强的伙伴特异性互惠性，以及对历史依赖型贡献标准的更高遵循度。这种行为分化伴随着线性公共物品博弈期间背内侧前额叶皮层更强的二元脑间同步。两种结构还引发了不同的个体神经活动模式以及dmPFC--rTPJ功能连接模式。这些发现表明，阈值公共物品博弈预期的协调优势可能无法推广到允许伙伴特异性资源分配的情境，凸显了分配灵活性在塑造博弈结构与合作行为之间关系中的重要性。

papers.title: A field-potential signature of pre-burst dynamics in human higher-order thalamic neurons
papers.translated_title: 人类高级丘脑神经元爆发前动态的场电位特征
papers.author: Varisa, L.
papers.summary: The aperiodic (1/f) component of the local field potential (LFP), long dismissed as noise, is increasingly being recognized as physiologically meaningful. Its exponent has been proposed to index excitation:inhibition (E:I) balance, with higher exponents (steeper spectra) corresponding to greater inhibition. Yet this hypothesis remains debated and has seldom been tested against single-neuron activity. Here, we used rare concurrent single-neuron and LFP recordings from the human pulvinar during goal-directed behavior and quiet wakefulness. Pulvinar recordings in both states revealed signatures of low-threshold calcium spikes (LTS) bursting. Prior work with intracellular recordings have established that LTS bursts require a sustained, spike-free period of hyperpolarization followed by a triggering depolarization, offering a physiologically-grounded test of the E:I hypothesis. We found that the exponent was higher during pre-burst silence relative to duration-matched silent windows preceding tonic spikes. The exponent also reflected the graded nature of burst-priming hyperpolarization: bursts with more constituent spikes followed longer silences and higher exponent peaks. Whereas these relationships held in both behavioral states, co-bursting across neurons exceeded chance only during goal-directed behavior. Co-bursts occurred on a slow (~100 ms) timescale, consistent with a shared cortical input mechanism, and were preceded by a larger rise in the exponent. Together, by linking a field potential measure to a known cellular mechanism, our findings show that the aperiodic exponent tracks the graded priming of thalamic bursts, providing human single-neuron support for the E:I hypothesis.
papers.translated_summary: 局部场电位（LFP）中的非周期（1/f）成分长期以来被视为噪声，如今日益被认为具有生理学意义。有人提出用其指数来标定兴奋:抑制（E:I）平衡，指数越高（频谱越陡）对应抑制越强。然而这一假说仍存争议，且很少针对单神经元活动进行检验。本研究利用人类丘脑枕在目标导向行为和安静清醒状态下罕见的单神经元与LFP同步记录。两种状态下的丘脑枕记录均揭示了低阈值钙尖峰（LTS）爆发的特征。此前的细胞内记录研究已确立，LTS爆发需要一个持续的、无尖峰的超极化期，随后是一次触发性的去极化，这为检验E:I假说提供了有生理学依据的手段。我们发现，相对于与紧张性尖峰前持续时间匹配的静息窗口，爆发前静息期间的指数更高。该指数还反映了爆发启动性超极化的分级性质：包含更多组成尖峰的爆发 preceded by 更长的静息时间和更高的指数峰值。这些关系在两种行为状态下均成立，而神经元间的共爆发仅在目标导向行为期间超过随机水平。共爆发发生在较慢（约100 ms）的时间尺度上，与共享的皮层输入机制一致，且其之前伴有指数更大幅度的上升。总之，通过将一项场电位指标与已知的细胞机制相联系，我们的发现表明非周期指数追踪丘脑爆发的分级启动，为E:I假说提供了人类单神经元层面的支持。

papers.title: Spatial Transcriptomics Reveals Age-Specific Cancer Hallmark Architecture in Pediatric and Adult Brain Tumors
papers.translated_title: 空间转录组学揭示儿童与成人脑肿瘤中年龄特异性的癌症标志架构
papers.author: Moffat, N. T.
papers.summary: Pediatric cancers are fundamentally different from their adult counterparts. Specifically, pediatric cancers carry fewer mutations, interact with developing immune systems, and have active developmental microenvironments. The tumor microenvironment (TME), which includes the surrounding stromal cells, immune cells, blood vessels, and extracellular matrix, plays a crucial role in cancer progression, metastasis, behavior, and treatment response. To better understand the effects of the pediatric tumor microenvironment on tumor gene expression, we acquired spatial transcriptomic data from 17 pediatric brain tumor samples and analyzed it through a Cancer Hallmarks framework. Cancer Hallmarks, as outlined by Hanahan and Weinberg, provide a comprehensive set of 14 biological capabilities that cancers acquire to enable tumor growth and metastasis. We compared the spatial gene expression patterns of the Cancer Hallmarks gene sets between the TME and neoplastic compartments in pediatric brain tumors. Compared with a similar study of adult brain tumors, in which Cancer Hallmark expression patterns clearly separated the TME and neoplastic compartments, we identified three hallmarks ("Deregulating Cellular Energetics," "Senescent Cells," and "Evading Growth Suppressors") whose predominant cellular compartments differed between pediatric and adult tumors. In pediatric samples, these hallmarks were associated primarily with the TME rather than the neoplastic compartment. This shift implicates an age-specific rewiring of the tumor ecosystem. We also provide clear evidence of strong transcriptomic regulation in genes shared by pediatric and adult neoplastic compartments. Finally, we show how measures of spatial autocorrelation may be used to distinguish tumor grade.
papers.translated_summary: 儿童癌症与成人癌症存在根本性差异。具体而言，儿童癌症携带的突变较少，与发育中的免疫系统相互作用，并具有活跃的发育性微环境。肿瘤微环境（TME）包括周围的基质细胞、免疫细胞、血管和细胞外基质，在癌症进展、转移、行为及治疗反应中发挥着关键作用。为更好地理解儿童肿瘤微环境对肿瘤基因表达的影响，我们获取了17例儿童脑肿瘤样本的空间转录组数据，并通过癌症标志框架进行分析。Hanahan和Weinberg提出的癌症标志提供了一套全面的14种生物学能力，这些能力是癌症为促进肿瘤生长和转移而获得的。我们比较了儿童脑肿瘤中TME与肿瘤区域之间癌症标志基因集的空间表达模式。与一项针对成人脑肿瘤的类似研究相比——该研究中癌症标志表达模式清晰区分了TME与肿瘤区域——我们识别出三个标志（“细胞能量代谢失调”、“衰老细胞”和“逃避生长抑制因子”），其主要细胞区域在儿童与成人肿瘤之间存在差异。在儿童样本中，这些标志主要与TME相关，而非肿瘤区域。这一转变暗示了肿瘤生态系统存在年龄特异性的重编程。我们还提供了明确证据，表明儿童与成人肿瘤区域共享基因存在强烈的转录组调控。最后，我们展示了空间自相关度量如何用于区分肿瘤分级。

papers.title: Bidirectional acetate exchange couples ethanol turnover to acetyl-CoA metabolism in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
papers.translated_title: 双向乙酸交换将乙醇周转与酿酒酵母中的乙酰辅酶A代谢耦合
papers.author: Carneiro, A.
papers.summary: Overflow metabolism describes the excretion of partially oxidized metabolites into the extracellular environment during rapid sugar utilization. Although these metabolites can later be reused, it remains unclear whether reassimilation also occurs during ongoing sugar consumption, and if so, how. Here, 13C-isotope tracing and metabolic flux analysis of acetate exchange in Saccharomyces cerevisiae during hexose utilization reveal that net acetate overflow is only the small difference between order-of-magnitude larger simultaneous excretion and assimilation fluxes. Unlike ethanol production, acetate exchange is not determined by hexose uptake but depends on metabolic processes downstream of glycolysis. Ethanol oxidation contributes to acetate excretion even during net ethanol production, directly linking the two main overflow pathways. We exploited this understanding to redirect extracellular acetate into the acetyl-CoA-derived product mevalonate. These results establish acetate overflow as a dynamic exchange linking ethanol turnover to acetyl-CoA metabolism, in which acetate is simultaneously an overflow product and a carbon source that can be redirected toward bioproduction.
papers.translated_summary: 溢出代谢描述的是在糖类快速利用过程中，部分氧化的代谢物被排泄到细胞外环境的现象。尽管这些代谢物随后可以被重新利用，但目前尚不清楚在糖类持续消耗过程中是否也会发生再同化，如果会，其机制如何。本文通过13C同位素示踪和酿酒酵母在己糖利用过程中乙酸交换的代谢通量分析揭示，净乙酸溢出仅是同时发生的排泄和同化通量之间的小差值，而这两个通量要大一个数量级。与乙醇产生不同，乙酸交换不由己糖摄取决定，而是取决于糖酵解下游的代谢过程。即使在净乙醇产生期间，乙醇氧化也有助于乙酸排泄，从而直接将两条主要的溢出途径联系起来。我们利用这一认识将细胞外乙酸重新导向乙酰辅酶A衍生产物甲羟戊酸。这些结果确立了乙酸溢出作为一种动态交换，将乙醇周转与乙酰辅酶A代谢联系起来，其中乙酸既是溢出产物，也是可被重新导向生物生产的碳源。

papers.title: N- and T-genes framework for pathway deregulation: Taxonomy, progression, and protection in cancer
papers.translated_title: N基因与T基因框架下的通路失调：癌症中的分类、进展与保护
papers.author: Nieves, J.
papers.summary: Background. Pathway analysis is widely used to interpret gene expression, but conventional enrichment depends on arbitrary thresholds and does not quantify deregulation magnitude. Recent reformulations based on average log-fold changes remove the threshold but still average over all annotated genes, diluting the signal from the genes that actually drive the normal-to-tumor transition. The N/T framework, which identifies genes with exclusive expression intervals in normal (N) or tumor (T) samples, offers a selective alternative, but it had not been extended to pathway- level quantification, taxonomy, or cross-cancer comparison. Methods. We define effective activation frequencies for Reactome pathways based on N- and T-genes: for each sample and pathway, the effective N (T) frequency is the fraction of annotated N (T) genes active in a normal (tumor) sample. The analysis proceeds in three explicit steps: (i) cohort averages identify the pathways important in each tissue; (ii) averages over hierarchical-clustering groups, ordered by the number of active genes, reveal sequences of pathway activation and deactivation along progression; (iii) a minimum spanning tree (MST) built on pathway-frequency vectors -- independent of the number of active genes -- defines the molecular taxonomy, and branch averages identify subtype-specific programs. We apply the framework to the full set of Reactome pathways in prostate adenocarcinoma (PRAD), lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC), and glioblastoma (GBM), analyzing both tumor and normal compartments. Results. In PRAD tumors (n=499), hierarchical clustering identifies four ordered progression groups and the MST resolves six main molecular subtypes comprising 406 tumors (81.4%): B1 (42.1%; MET/NFE2L2/energy metabolism), B2 (13.8%; RAS/apoptosis/telomere), and four smaller subtypes defined by PTEN (B3), DNA repair and lipid metabolism (B4), inflammation and LXR-mediated lipid metabolism (B5), and neuronal development and base excision repair (B6). An eight-gene perfect T panel reproduces the MST subtypes at gene level. Analysis of normal prostatic tissue (n=52) reveals a hierarchy of protection: immune response, apoptosis, and senescence are lost or partially lost early, DNA repair at an intermediate stage, and cell cycle regulation and receptor tyrosine kinase signaling last; an eleven-gene N panel reproduces this hierarchy at gene level. The cross-cancer comparison shows that this architecture is a general property: DNA repair, cell cycle, and RTK protection are maintained in normal tissue across PRAD, LUAD, LIHC, and GBM, while the specific pathways lost in normals and gained in tumors are tissue-specific (MET/NFE2L2 in PRAD; NTRK/LXR/phagosome in LIHC; surfactant/FGFR/glycosylation in LUAD; TP53loss/lipid metabolism/glycosylation in GBM). Taxonomic heterogeneity decreases from PRAD (six subtypes) to LIHC (two) to LUAD and GBM (one dominant program), paralleling an increase in the number of activated T-genes. Conclusions. The framework eliminates dilution by non-nformative genes, quantifies pathway deregulation sample by sample, and unifies tumor taxonomy with a molecular indicator of progression. Its most distinctive contribution is the joint analysis of normal and tumor compartments across cancer types, which links loss of protection in normal tissue to gain of progression programs in tumors and reveals both shared and tissue-specific cancer mechanisms. The method is general and applicable across cancer types, although quantitative results depend on the underlying cohort.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。通路分析被广泛用于解读基因表达，但传统的富集分析依赖于任意阈值，且无法量化失调程度。近期基于平均对数倍数变化的重新表述消除了阈值，但仍对所有注释基因取平均，稀释了真正驱动正常向肿瘤转变的基因信号。N/T框架通过识别在正常（N）或肿瘤（T）样本中具有排他表达区间的基因，提供了一种选择性替代方案，但此前尚未扩展到通路水平的量化、分类学或跨癌种比较。方法。我们基于N基因和T基因定义了Reactome通路的有效激活频率：对于每个样本和通路，有效N（T）频率为在正常（肿瘤）样本中活跃的注释N（T）基因的比例。分析按三个明确步骤进行：（i）队列平均值识别各组织中重要的通路；（ii）按活跃基因数量排序的层次聚类组的平均值揭示进展过程中通路激活和失活的序列；（iii）基于通路频率向量构建的最小生成树（MST）——独立于活跃基因数量——定义分子分类学，分支平均值识别亚型特异性程序。我们将该框架应用于前列腺腺癌（PRAD）、肺腺癌（LUAD）、肝细胞癌（LIHC）和胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）中全套Reactome通路，分析肿瘤和正常 compartments。结果。在PRAD肿瘤（n=499）中，层次聚类识别出四个有序进展组，MST解析出六个主要分子亚型，涵盖406例肿瘤（81.4%）：B1（42.1%；MET/NFE2L2/能量代谢）、B2（13.8%；RAS/凋亡/端粒）以及四个由PTEN（B3）、DNA修复和脂质代谢（B4）、炎症和LXR介导的脂质代谢（B5）、神经元发育和碱基切除修复（B6）定义的较小亚型。一个八基因完美T面板在基因水平上重现了MST亚型。对正常前列腺组织（n=52）的分析揭示了保护层级：免疫应答、凋亡和衰老早期丢失或部分丢失，DNA修复处于中间阶段，细胞周期调控和受体酪氨酸激酶信号传导最后丢失；一个十一基因N面板在基因水平上重现了该层级。跨癌种比较表明该架构是一般性属性：DNA修复、细胞周期和RTK保护在PRAD、LUAD、LIHC和GBM的正常组织中均得以维持，而在正常组织中丢失、在肿瘤中获得的具体通路具有组织特异性（PRAD中的MET/NFE2L2；LIHC中的NTRK/LXR/吞噬体；LUAD中的表面活性物质/FGFR/糖基化；GBM中的TP53丢失/脂质代谢/糖基化）。分类学异质性从PRAD（六个亚型）到LIHC（两个）到LUAD和GBM（一个主导程序）递减，与激活T基因数量的增加平行。结论。该框架消除了非信息基因的稀释，逐样本量化通路失调，并将肿瘤分类学与进展的分子指标统一起来。其最独特的贡献是跨癌种对正常和肿瘤 compartments 的联合分析，这将正常组织中保护的丧失与肿瘤中进展程序的获得联系起来，并揭示了共享的和组织特异性的癌症机制。该方法具有通用性，适用于跨癌种，尽管定量结果取决于 underlying cohort。

papers.title: What Australian Health Practitioner Tribunals Decide, and What Automated Analysis Misses: 3,586 Decisions, 1999 to February 2026
papers.translated_title: 澳大利亚健康从业者法庭裁决什么，以及自动化分析遗漏了什么：1999年至2026年2月的3586份裁决
papers.author: Farquhar, H. L.
papers.summary: Background: Australian health practitioners are regulated under the Health Practitioner Regulation National Law, with serious conduct matters referred to state and territory tribunals. Despite thousands of published tribunal decisions, no prior study has applied computational text analysis to this corpus. Manual coding has limited previous work to narrow slices of the problem -- typically one profession, one jurisdiction, or one misconduct type. Methods: Natural language processing was applied to 3,586 tribunal decisions (1999-2026) across all eight Australian jurisdictions. A multi-label text classifier (TF-IDF logistic regression) was trained on 367 annotated decisions to categorise misconduct across seven types. Outcomes were extracted via rule-based methods. Chi-square tests, Fisher's exact tests, and Mann-Kendall trend tests assessed associations and temporal trends. Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction was applied across 63 statistical tests. Classifier performance was evaluated on a held-out test set (n = 45) and error-adjusted prevalence estimates were computed using the Rogan-Gladen estimator. Results: Of 3,586 decisions, 2,428 (67.7%) involved disciplinary proceedings. Classifier performance varied by category (per-class F1 0.47-0.82). Boundary violations were the most prevalent misconduct type (30.2%), followed by dishonesty/fraud (29.7%) and professional conduct breaches (28.0%). Reprimand was the most common outcome (53.0%), followed by registration cancellation (40.2%). Significant increasing temporal trends were identified for boundary violations (tau = 0.296, p = 0.032), dishonesty/fraud (tau = 0.564, p < 0.001), professional conduct breaches (tau = 0.396, p = 0.004), and communication failures (tau = 0.667, p < 0.001). Boundary violations were associated with higher cancellation odds (OR = 1.36, p < 0.001). Opioid medications appeared in 67% of prescribing misconduct decisions. Significant jurisdictional variation in both misconduct types and outcomes was observed, with large pairwise effect sizes (Cramer's V up to 0.502). Conclusions: This study provides the first large-scale computational analysis of Australian health practitioner tribunal decisions, identifying temporal trends, jurisdictional variation, and misconduct-outcome associations across a corpus more than four times larger than any prior manual study. The significant jurisdictional variation raises questions about consistency of regulatory outcomes under the nationally uniform framework. The concentration of opioid medications in prescribing misconduct decisions is consistent with the documented burden of pharmaceutical opioid harm in Australia. Classifier limitations for rare misconduct categories (dishonesty/fraud, communication failures) mean that prevalence estimates for these types should be treated as lower bounds.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：澳大利亚的医疗从业人员受《医疗从业人员监管国家法》监管，严重的执业行为问题会被提交至州和领地法庭审理。尽管已公布了数千份法庭裁决，但此前尚无研究对该语料库应用计算文本分析。人工编码使以往的研究局限于问题的狭窄切片——通常只涉及一个职业、一个司法管辖区或一种不当行为类型。方法：对澳大利亚全部八个司法管辖区1999年至2026年间的3586份法庭裁决应用了自然语言处理。基于367份标注裁决训练了一个多标签文本分类器（TF-IDF逻辑回归），将不当行为分为七种类型。结果通过基于规则的方法提取。采用卡方检验、Fisher精确检验和Mann-Kendall趋势检验评估关联性和时间趋势。对63项统计检验应用了Benjamini-Hochberg错误发现率校正。在留出测试集（n = 45）上评估了分类器性能，并使用Rogan-Gladen估计量计算了经误差校正的患病率估计值。结果：在3586份裁决中，2428份（67.7%）涉及纪律程序。分类器性能因类别而异（各类别F1为0.47-0.82）。边界违规是最常见的不当行为类型（30.2%），其次是欺诈/不诚实（29.7%）和职业行为违规（28.0%）。谴责是最常见的处理结果（53.0%），其次是注销注册（40.2%）。边界违规（tau = 0.296，p = 0.032）、欺诈/不诚实（tau = 0.564，p < 0.001）、职业行为违规（tau = 0.396，p = 0.004）和沟通失败（tau = 0.667，p < 0.001）均呈现出显著上升的时间趋势。边界违规与更高的注销几率相关（OR = 1.36，p < 0.001）。阿片类药物出现在67%的处方不当行为裁决中。观察到不当行为类型和处理结果均存在显著的司法管辖区差异，两两效应量较大（Cramer's V最高达0.502）。结论：本研究首次对澳大利亚医疗从业人员法庭裁决进行了大规模计算分析，在一个比以往任何人工研究大四倍以上的语料库中识别了时间趋势、司法管辖区差异以及不当行为与处理结果之间的关联。显著的司法管辖区差异引发了关于在国家统一框架下监管结果一致性的疑问。处方不当行为裁决中阿片类药物的集中出现与澳大利亚已记录的处方阿片类药物危害负担相一致。分类器对罕见不当行为类别（欺诈/不诚实、沟通失败）的局限性意味着这些类型的患病率估计值应被视为下限。

papers.title: Objective sleep tracking for fatigue management in cargo pilots: six months of continuous smart-ring monitoring
papers.translated_title: 货运飞行员疲劳管理中的客观睡眠监测：连续六个月智能戒指监测
papers.author: Dhawale, N.
papers.summary: Aviation fatigue management estimates crew sleep from rosters and self-report. We examined how sleep duration changes around flights and with departure and landing times. In an observational cohort study, 13 cargo pilots wore an Ultrahuman smart ring for six months in 2026. We linked 1,504 sleep sessions to the flown schedule. Linear mixed-effects models compared each sleep session with the same pilot's rest nights, with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Total sleep time was 48 min shorter on the night before a flight (95% CI 32 to 65 min) and 28 min shorter in the first sleep after one (95% CI 13 to 43 min). Later nights did not differ. Sleep duration varied with clock time. Compared with evening departures and landings, respectively, pilots slept 57 min less before a departure between 06:00h and 11:59h (95% CI 14 to 101 min) and 97 min less after a landing between 00:00h and 05:59h (95% CI 37 to 156 min). Flight direction and length showed no association. Differences between pilots explained 14.1% of the variance in total sleep time, more than six times the 2.2% explained by duty position. Fatigue risk management could plan rest around departure and landing times.

papers.title: Longitudinal Investigation of Autonomic Symptoms in Biologically Confirmed (SAA+) Parkinson's Disease
papers.translated_title: 生物学确认（SAA+）帕金森病自主神经症状的纵向研究
papers.author: Memon, A. A.
papers.summary: Background Autonomic symptoms are common in Parkinson disease (PD) and impact quality of life, with unclear relationship to motor and cognitive progression. Objective: Characterize five-year progression of autonomic symptoms in early PD and their association with motor and cognitive outcomes. Methods We analyzed data from 874 PD participants and 252 healthy controls (HC) enrolled in Parkinsons Precision Medicine Initiative (PPMI). Autonomic symptoms were assessed annually over five years using Scales for Outcomes in Parkinson's disease-Autonomic dysfunction (SCOPA-AUT); affected autonomic domains were defined as domain subscore >1. Clinical measures included MDS-UPDRS and Montreal Cognitive Assessment. Generalized estimating equations evaluated longitudinal changes, adjusting for age, sex, medication, and comorbidities. Results: At baseline, 71% of PD participants reported >1 affected autonomic domain, increasing to 85% among 287 PD participants with 5-year follow-up; HCs reporting >1 affected autonomic domain increased from 40% of participants at baseline to 46% among 145 participants with 5-year follow-up. Gastrointestinal and urinary symptoms were most prevalent in PD. Medication use for constipation and urinary dysfunction increased over time in PD. Cardiovascular comorbidities were common and increased in prevalence in both groups. Greater baseline autonomic symptom burden predicted more rapid cognitive, but not motor decline in PD (p=0.002). Conclusion: Autonomic symptoms in PD are common at disease onset, near universal after 5 years, and associated with faster cognitive, but not motor, decline, driven by those with severe symptoms. The high prevalence and impact of autonomic symptoms in early PD highlights the importance of early assessment and management of these symptoms.

papers.title: Virtual brain twins guide personalized treatment decision in schizophrenia
papers.translated_title: 虚拟大脑孪生引导精神分裂症的个性化治疗决策
papers.author: Preti, G.
papers.summary: Schizophrenia is a complex psychiatric disorder whose pathophysiology spans multiple spatial and temporal scales. Structural and functional neuroimaging studies have identified a broad range of disease-associated markers encompassing cortical atrophy, white matter disruptions, and aberrant functional connectivity patterns. Their application to personalized diagnosis and treatment selection has remained elusive. Here, we introduce the first Virtual Brain Twin (VBT) pipeline that integrates individual connectome-based network models with multimodal neuroimaging data, incorporating patient-specific structural connectivity, cortical thickness, and resting-state fMRI features to construct personalised whole-brain dynamical models. Dopaminergic and serotonergic signaling pathways are embedded within a mean-field framework, and simulation-based inference (SBI) is used to recover key pathophysiological parameters from individual patient data. The validity of this inference is first established using synthetic patients with known ground truth parameters, confirming that the pipeline can accurately identify underlying neurochemical states from simulated functional data. Applied to a cohort of 33 subjects in three clinical centers, the framework identifies personalized pathophysiological parameter regimes consistent with current neurobiological hypotheses of schizophrenia, including reduced cortical dopaminergic drive and elevated subcortical dopaminergic drive relative to healthy controls. Simulated pharmacological interventions within the VBT generate individualized medication effect trajectories that align retrospectively with known treatment outcomes (66.6\% accuracy), demonstrating the framework's capacity to capture patient-specific pharmacological responses. These results establish a principled and extensible computational foundation for neuroimaging-guided personalized medicine in psychiatry, with direct implications for two prospective clinical trials conducted in Marseille and Munich as part of the Virtual Brain Twin project, designed to evaluate VBT-guided individualised antipsychotic treatment selection.
papers.translated_summary: 精神分裂症是一种复杂的精神疾病，其病理生理机制跨越多个空间和时间尺度。结构和功能神经影像学研究已识别出广泛的疾病相关标志物，包括皮层萎缩、白质破坏和异常功能连接模式。然而，这些标志物在个性化诊断和治疗选择中的应用仍然难以实现。在此，我们介绍了首个虚拟大脑孪生（Virtual Brain Twin, VBT）流程，该流程将基于个体连接组的网络模型与多模态神经影像数据相结合，整合患者特异性结构连接、皮层厚度和静息态fMRI特征，以构建个性化全脑动力学模型。多巴胺能和血清素能信号通路被嵌入均值场框架中，并采用基于模拟的推断（simulation-based inference, SBI）从个体患者数据中恢复关键病理生理参数。该推断的有效性首先通过具有已知真实参数的合成患者得以验证，确认该流程能够从模拟功能数据中准确识别潜在的神经化学状态。应用于三个临床中心共33名受试者的队列中，该框架识别出与当前精神分裂症神经生物学假说一致的个性化病理生理参数区域，包括相对于健康对照者皮层多巴胺能驱动降低和皮层下多巴胺能驱动升高。在VBT内模拟的药理学干预生成了个体化药物效应轨迹，这些轨迹在回顾性分析中与已知治疗结果相符（准确率66.6%），证明了该框架捕捉患者特异性药理学反应的能力。这些结果为精神病学中神经影像引导的个性化医疗建立了有原则且可扩展的计算基础，并对作为虚拟大脑孪生项目一部分在马赛和慕尼黑开展的两项前瞻性临床试验具有直接意义，这两项试验旨在评估VBT引导的个体化抗精神病药物治疗选择。

papers.title: Research Involvement and Partnership Outcomes Among Patient-Centered Outcomes Research Partners
papers.translated_title: 以患者为中心的结果研究合作伙伴的研究参与度与合作成果
papers.author: Tapiavala, V. N.
papers.summary: Importance: Meaningful patient and community involvement is increasingly emphasized in health research. Still, little is known about how such research involvement relates to the quality of patient and community partnerships. Objective: To examine the associations of patient and community involvement in research with partnership outcomes. The associations of patient involvement in specific research phases (e.g., grant writing, recruitment, and data collection) with these metrics were examined as a secondary objective. Design: This cross-sectional observational study used baseline data from a national cohort study across the United States collected from September to December 2024. Setting: This national study was conducted online with recruitment occurring over multiple channels. Participants: Participants included patient and community research partners aged 18 years and older and were recruited in a convenience sample. Exposures: The extent to which participants have contributed to prior research studies were calculated by adding binary indicators representing their involvement in phases of the research process. These indicators were examined individually as secondary exposures. Main Outcome(s) and Measure(s): Primary outcomes included partnership quality and research engagement, with trust in medical researchers and partnership recommendation as secondary and tertiary outcomes. Multivariable linear and modified Poisson regressions were utilized to estimate regression coefficients and adjusted prevalence ratios (aPRs). Results: Among 330 participants (mean age = 36.5 years, SD = 9.7), 56.1% were male, and 37.3% and 31.8% were White or Black, respectively. Involvement in patient-centered outcomes research was associated with partnership quality ({beta}, 0.86; 95% CI, 0.30-1.42, P=0.003), research engagement ({beta}, 0.04; 95% CI, 0.01-0.06, P=0.006), trust in medical researchers ({beta}, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.31-1.07, P<0.001), and greater willingness to recommend becoming a research partner (aPR, 1.09; 95% CI, 1.05-1.14, P<0.001). Conclusions and Relevance: Patient-centered outcomes research may provide patient and community research partners with a sense of shared ownership, improving partnership quality. While the causal links require further investigation, these associations may be driven by inclusion in recruitment, grant writing, data collection, and shared governance.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：患者和社区的有意义参与在健康研究中日益受到重视。然而，关于这种研究参与如何与患者和社区伙伴关系的质量相关联，目前知之甚少。目的：考察患者和社区在研究中的参与与伙伴关系结局之间的关联。次要目的是考察患者在特定研究阶段（如基金撰写、招募和数据收集）的参与与这些指标之间的关联。设计：本横断面观察性研究使用了2024年9月至12月在美国全国范围内收集的全国队列研究的基线数据。环境：本全国性研究在线进行，通过多种渠道招募。参与者：参与者包括年龄18岁及以上的患者和社区研究伙伴，采用便利样本招募。暴露：通过将代表参与者参与研究过程各阶段的二元指标相加，计算参与者对既往研究研究的贡献程度。这些指标作为次要暴露单独进行分析。主要结局和测量指标：主要结局包括伙伴关系质量和研究参与度，对医学研究者的信任和伙伴关系推荐作为次要和第三结局。采用多变量线性回归和改良Poisson回归估计回归系数和调整患病率比（aPRs）。结果：在330名参与者中（平均年龄=36.5岁，SD=9.7），56.1%为男性，37.3%和31.8%分别为白人或黑人。参与以患者为中心的结果研究与伙伴关系质量（{beta}，0.86；95% CI，0.30-1.42，P=0.003）、研究参与度（{beta}，0.04；95% CI，0.01-0.06，P=0.006）、对医学研究者的信任（{beta}，0.69；95% CI，0.31-1.07，P<0.001）以及更高的推荐成为研究伙伴的意愿（aPR，1.09；95% CI，1.05-1.14，P<0.001）相关。结论与意义：以患者为中心的结果研究可能为患者和社区研究伙伴提供一种共享所有权感，从而改善伙伴关系质量。虽然因果关系需要进一步研究，但这些关联可能由招募、基金撰写、数据收集和共享治理中的包容性所驱动。

papers.title: Rising Tuberculosis Presentations in Ontario, Canada Are Not Explained by Community SARS-CoV-2 Activity: A Population-Based Time-Series Study
papers.translated_title: 加拿大安大略省结核病病例上升无法用社区SARS-CoV-2活动解释：一项基于人群的时间序列研究
papers.author: Wilson, N. J.
papers.summary: Background: Tuberculosis (TB) notifications have increased in several high-income countries since 2020. Proposed explanations include pandemic related disruption of treatment for latent tuberculosis, changes in population composition, and immune dysfunction following SARS CoV 2 infection. We assessed whether TB presentations increased during the pandemic era and then tested whether community SARS CoV 2 activity was followed by increased mycobacterial disease. Methods: We conducted a population-based ecological time-series study of first TB- and nontuberculous mycobacterial (NTM)-coded hospital, emergency-department and ambulatory clinic presentations in the Greater Toronto/Hamilton Area Plus (GTHA+), Ontario (2024 population approximately 11.2 million), from April 2011 through March 2024. NTM served as a comparator because it shares diagnostic pathways with TB but differs epidemiologically. Negative binomial projection and full-series models estimated pandemic-era changes under three alternative trend assumptions. Distributed lag non linear models estimated cumulative rate ratios for standardized community viral activity over 0 to 12 weeks; sensitivity analyses extended the maximum lag to 26 and 52 weeks. Influenza and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) were prespecified comparators; data for five additional viral exposures were obtained after the primary analysis was completed and analysed as exploratory comparisons. Results: We identified 3,985 first TB-coded and 5,214 first NTM-coded acute-care presentations. Across six models, estimated pandemic-era TB increases ranged from 3% to 22%. No model suggested an increased in NTM. SARS-CoV-2 activity was not positively associated with TB (cumulative rate ratio per 1-SD increase over 0 to 12 weeks 0.909, 95% CI 0.822 to 1.006) or NTM (0.953, 0.868 to 1.047). No positive associations were identified in subgroup analyses or with maximum lags of 26 or 52 weeks. Influenza was not associated with either outcome. RSV was associated with TB and NTM; only the RSV/NTM association met the Bonferroni threshold among the prespecified comparisons, and no exploratory associations met the experiment wide threshold. Conclusions: We identified a modest pandemic era increase in TB-coded acute-care presentations in Ontario, Canada, although its estimated size depended on assumptions about underlying trends. NTM-coded presentations did not increase. Community SARS-CoV-2 activity was not positively associated with subsequent TB or NTM presentations at lags of up to one year and did not provide a temporal explanation for the population-level TB increase. Individual-level effects cannot be excluded.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：自2020年以来，多个高收入国家的结核病（TB）报告数有所增加。提出的解释包括大流行相关的潜伏性结核治疗中断、人口构成变化以及SARS CoV 2感染后的免疫功能障碍。我们评估了大流行时期结核病就诊是否增加，随后检验了社区SARS CoV 2活动之后是否出现分枝杆菌疾病增加。方法：我们在安大略省大多伦多/汉密尔顿扩展区（GTHA+）（2024年人口约1120万）开展了一项基于人群的生态学时间序列研究，研究对象为2011年4月至2024年3月期间首次以结核病和非结核分枝杆菌（NTM）编码的医院、急诊科和门诊就诊。NTM作为对照，因为它与结核病共享诊断路径但流行病学特征不同。负二项预测和全序列模型在三种替代趋势假设下估计了大流行时期的变化。分布滞后非线性模型估计了标准化社区病毒活动在0至12周内的累积率比；敏感性分析将最大滞后延长至26周和52周。流感和呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）为预设对照；另外五种病毒暴露的数据在主要分析完成后获得，并作为探索性比较进行分析。结果：我们识别了3，985例首次结核病编码和5，214例首次NTM编码的急性护理就诊。在六个模型中，估计的大流行时期结核病增加范围为3%至22%。没有模型提示NTM增加。SARS-CoV-2活动与结核病（0至12周内每1-SD增加的累积率比0.909，95% CI 0.822至1.006）或NTM（0.953，0.868至1.047）均无正相关。在亚组分析中或最大滞后为26周或52周时，均未发现正相关。流感与任一结局均无关。RSV与结核病和NTM均相关；在预设比较中，仅RSV/NTM关联达到Bonferroni阈值，且没有探索性关联达到实验-wide阈值。结论：我们在加拿大安大略省发现大流行时期结核病编码的急性护理就诊有适度增加，尽管其估计幅度取决于对 underlying trends 的假设。NTM编码就诊未增加。社区SARS-CoV-2活动在长达一年的滞后期内与随后的结核病或NTM就诊无正相关，且不能为人群水平的结核病增加提供时间学解释。个体水平效应不能排除。

papers.title: Old lineages, new threat: the re-emergence of pneumococcal serotype 14 in adults in Catalonia, Spain (2023-2025).
papers.translated_title: 旧谱系，新威胁：西班牙加泰罗尼亚地区成人肺炎链球菌14型血清型的再现（2023—2025年）。
papers.author: Gonzalez-Diaz, A.
papers.summary: Introduction: The introduction of pneumococcal conjugate vaccines resulted in a decline in invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD). Nevertheless, recent studies report a re-emergence of vaccine-included serotypes. Aim: To describe the recent re-emergence of serotype 14 IPD among adults in Catalonia and to investigate the factors underlying its resurgence. Methods: We analysed two collections of adult IPD isolates: a historical series from Hospital Universitari de Bellvitge (1996-2025) and a multicentre series from seven tertiary hospitals in Catalonia (2023-2025). Isolates were serotyped (Quellung) and genotyped by PFGE/MLST (1996-2022) or Illumina sequencing (2023-2025). Clinical data were retrospectively collected. Results: The historical series showed that, after peaking in 2009, serotype 14 frequency gradually declined, with only -4 cases reported annually between 2016 and 2020. However, the number of serotype 14 isolates increased again in 2025, reaching 11.0% of all isolates at HUB and 10.8% across Catalonia. Genomic data showed that this increase involved multiple previously circulating lineages (GPSC6, GPSC18, GPSC16 and GPSC39), with no dominant clone. Analysis of the capsular locus revealed substantial genetic diversity, with no association between capsular variants and either lineage or year of isolation. A substantial proportion of patients (56.3%) had multiple comorbidities and only 18.8% were appropriately vaccinated. Discussion: The re-emergence of serotype 14 was not associated with a novel lineage or capsular variant. Instead, it may reflect a combination of post-pandemic transmission changes, higher-valency paediatric vaccines, and natural fluctuations in serotype circulation. These findings highlight the limits of herd protection and underscore the need to strengthen adult vaccination, particularly among at-risk populations.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：肺炎球菌结合疫苗的引入导致侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病（IPD）下降。然而，近期研究报告疫苗所含血清型重新出现。目的：描述加泰罗尼亚成年人中14型IPD近期重新出现的情况，并探讨其 resurgence 的潜在因素。方法：我们分析了两个成人IPD分离株集合：来自贝尔维特格大学医院的历史系列（1996-2025年）和来自加泰罗尼亚七家三级医院的多中心系列（2023-2025年）。分离株通过Quellung进行血清分型，并通过PFGE/MLST（1996-2022年）或Illumina测序（2023-2025年）进行基因分型。临床数据为回顾性收集。结果：历史系列显示，在2009年达到峰值后，14型频率逐渐下降，2016年至2020年间每年仅报告-4例。然而，2025年14型分离株数量再次增加，在HUB达到所有分离株的11.0%，在加泰罗尼亚各地达到10.8%。基因组数据显示，这一增加涉及多个先前流行的谱系（GPSC6、GPSC18、GPSC16和GPSC39），没有优势克隆。荚膜位点分析显示 substantial 遗传多样性，荚膜变异与谱系或分离年份均无关联。相当比例的患者（56.3%）有多种合并症，仅18.8%接种了适当疫苗。讨论：14型的重新出现与新型谱系或荚膜变异无关。相反，它可能反映了大流行后传播变化、更高价儿童疫苗以及血清型循环的自然波动的综合作用。这些发现凸显了群体保护的限制，并强调需要加强成人疫苗接种，尤其是在高危人群中。

papers.title: B-cell involvement supports anti-CD20 therapy in paediatric rheumatic heart disease: Proof of concept and initial safety
papers.translated_title: B细胞参与支持抗CD20治疗在儿童风湿性心脏病中的应用：概念验证与初步安全性
papers.author: Jouven, X.
papers.summary: Rheumatic heart disease (RHD) remains a major cause of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality, particularly in low- and middle-income countries, yet no therapy targets its underlying autoimmune mechanisms. We combined transcriptomic analyses of rheumatic mitral valves tissues with a translational approach. Using a panel of 750 mRNAs, we found a marked upregulation of B-cell-related pathways, including CD20-associated and multiple immunoglobulin genes, supporting a pathogenic role of B cells in RHD. We therefore evaluated an anti-CD20 B-cell depleting monoclonal antibody (Rituximab), in a feasibility study in children with RHD, in Dakar, Senegal. Treatment was well tolerated, and in the following RCT first year preliminary safety analysis asked by the ethical committee, children who received rituximab showed a decrease in anti-streptolysin O titers and clinical improvement compared to controls. This proof-of-concept reveals B cells as a therapeutic target and suggests that an anti-CD20 agent may represent a potential disease-modifying therapy for RHD.

papers.title: Cardiorespiratory Limits Exist in HFpEF Independent of Age and BMI
papers.translated_title: 心肺运动试验在HFpEF中存在独立于年龄和BMI的心肺功能限制
papers.author: LaGalbo, S.
papers.summary: Background: Heart-failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) is a clinical syndrome marked by exercise intolerance associated with impairments in cardiac and respiratory performance. HFpEF is associated with age and weight; however, it remains unclear whether cardiorespiratory limitations exist independent of these comorbidities. Hypothesis: Independent of age and BMI, there are cardiorespiratory limitations inherent to the HFpEF syndrome that have yet to be fully elicited. Methods: A patient cohort with a clinical diagnosis of HFpEF (HFpEF; N = 38) and counterparts without identifiable cardiopulmonary disease (control; N = 21) underwent phenotyping with echocardiography and cardiopulmonary exercise testing with invasive hemodynamic monitoring. Results: Study cohorts were similar in age, BMI and height (p=NS for all metrics). Body-surface area (BSA) (2.1 m2 v 1.9 m2, p < 0.05), atrial fibrillation prevalence (50 v 14%, p < 0.05), and average E/e (11.5 v 9.5, p < 0.05) were elevated within the HFpEF cohort. Peak VO2 (14.1 v 19.1 mL/Kg/min, p < 0.001) was also diminished among those with HFpEF. Resting (17.1 v 11.4mmHg, p < 0.001) and exercise wedge pressures (29.3 v 16.7mmHg, p < 0.001) were elevated whereas stroke volume (93.3 v 110.4 mL, p < 0.05) and cardiac output (Direct Fick; 8.0 v 9.8, p < 0.05) during exercise were diminished in HFpEF patients. FVC, FVC%, FEV1 and FEV1% were also significantly diminished in the HFpEF cohort. Conclusions: Cardiorespiratory limitations exist as a feature of the HFpEF syndrome, independent of age and BMI. BSA remained associated with HFpEF in keeping with adiposity as a feature of pathophysiology.

papers.title: Risk-Based Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Staging Identifies a Population With Mortality Comparable to Established Cardiovascular Disease: Disability-Adjusted Life Years Across AHA Stages, 2005 to 2023
papers.translated_title: 基于风险的心血管-肾脏-代谢分期识别出死亡率与确诊心血管疾病相当的人群：2005至2023年AHA各分期的伤残调整生命年

papers.summary: BackgroundCardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome was defined in 2023 as a five-stage continuum, with stage 3 assigned on predicted rather than established cardiovascular disease. Whether that stage identifies a population whose mortality resembles clinical disease, and how health loss is distributed across stages, is unknown. MethodsWe pooled nine National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey cycles (2005-2023) and assigned CKM stages 0-4 from measured risk factors, kidney function, urine albumin, self-reported cardiovascular disease, and 10-year PREVENT risk. Years lived with disability used Global Burden of Disease weights; years of life lost combined national death counts, linked mortality files, and period life tables. ResultsIn 2021-2023, 13.8%, 21.3%, 49.1%, 6.5%, and 9.3% of adults were in stages 0 to 4, respectively. Crude mortality was 6,709 per 100,000 person-years in stage 3, comparable to 6,375 in stage 4. Adjusted hazard ratios rose from 1.39 in stage 2 to 3.22 in stage 4, with no excess in stage 1 (0.99). CKM accounted for 20.0 million DALYs annually, with 76% of attributable years of life lost in stages 3-4. Lipid-lowering therapy was absent in 53.7% of stage 3 and 33.6% of stage 4 adults, a gap unchanged over 16 years. Stage 0 prevalence fell 2.3% per year and stage 1 rose 3.1% per year between 2006 and 2016. ConclusionsRisk-based stage 3 carries short-term mortality indistinguishable from established cardiovascular disease, yet the population continues to shift into stage 1, where mortality is normal, and stage 3 receives less intensive lipid-lowering treatment than stage 4.
